title: Fourier coefficient under character multiplication
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and let $a,\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the function obtained by multiplying $f$ pointwise by the Walsh character indexed by $a$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $a+\gamma$.
